Reference measurements

How to use the studio
  1. Choose a portrait or try the example.
  2. Fit the circle to the cranium with size, tilt and face turn.
  3. Place blue points on the cheek, jaw, eyes and lips.
  4. Hide the photo to inspect your structure, or download the study.
